correctness.rationale: Finite W yields characteristic formulas for complete pointed modal-theory classes by finite conjunction of pairwise distinguishing formulas, so definable sets are all unions of type classes. Under the KRep biconditional, truth preservation is equivalent to every row of each required block i->j being nonempty, every forbidden block zero. Any isomorphism preserves each type class, and all permutations inside a class preserve the allowed set. For a row cycle of length a and target permutation partition lambda_j, invariant nonempty subsets are 2^{sum_{b in lambda_j}gcd(a,b)}-1. Burnside averaging over product symmetric groups gives exactly the stated partition formula including i=j coupled permutations. Independently brute enumerated 3-world single-type allowed matrices and their S3 orbits: 343 labelled, 70 orbits; directly derived 4-world Burnside fixed values 50625,735,225,45,15 giving 2340. The theorem counts only same-carrier same-valuation fixed-pointwise-truth representations, not generic modally equivalent frames and offers no algorithm to compute infinite modal theories from arbitrary closures.
residual_risks: No finite computation establishes infinite-parameter coverage; the reconstructed algebraic proof supplies the stated general scope.

While Burnside is classical and the derivation compact, this exact complete classification can be independently useful; it is not presented as a new general orbit lemma.
